admission.justification: A surviving workflow that points at a removed carryover procedure reads as executable authority but cannot be followed; the reference must resolve to the kept carryover workflow.

applicability: Every executable reference from a surviving lifecycle workflow to a carryover procedure.
conditions: Each reference resolves to the kept carryover workflow that states the procedure.
exclusions: Rebuilding a retired skill to keep a reference alive.
statement: Every surviving executable carryover reference resolves to the kept carryover workflow that states the procedure.
